primer: UnitedHealth Group retains a durable healthcare scale moat generating $25.09 billion in 9M 2026 operating cash flow, yet Q3 2026 footnotes expose $1.77 billion in reserve-release tailwinds, CY2027 Medicare Advantage rate lag, March 2026 IRS transfer-pricing NOPAs, and Negative outlooks across all three rating agencies [29]. Following a -16.67% weekly crash to $339.85 on 2.01x volume, UNH entered Stage 4 (CAP_REJECTED) inside a 10-distribution-day U.S. Downtrend and cleanly breached our prior $358.00 structural stop. New capital is REJECTED (TIER_0), and we mandate an immediate exit of all 4.6973 Charles Schwab shares (~$1,596.38 proceeds) into 100% USD cash.
